description.text:
Battle Party: Shining Dream (对战派对 耀梦) is a box of ready-made decks for a battle party of up to eight players, following Battle Party: Dream Together. It came in two parts, each with nine decks: part one (上) on 18 July 2025 and part two (下) on 17 October 2025. Each box held eight of its part's 60-card decks with a card explaining how each plays, eight sheets of paper damage counters, four coins, a one-card King's Reward Pack (王者奖赏包) for the winner and 20 Collect 151 event packs to hand out by result. With luck the eight decks included part one's Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR deck or part two's Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR deck, or its holo version, the same cards in holo.

Part one's decks are built around Keldeo with Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion, Blastoise with Kingdra, Kyurem with Baxcalibur, Entei V, Absol ex, Alakazam ex, Annihilape ex, Hisuian Lilligant VSTAR and Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR; part two's include Flareon VMAX with Camerupt, Lycanroc with Lucario, Copperajah ex, Wigglytuff ex, Regieleki VMAX, Ho-Oh V, Hisuian Samurott VSTAR and Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR. At first the boxes could be played only at Battle Party: Shining Dream events in shops, from 18 July to 21 September 2025 for part one and from 17 October to 9 November for part two. From 19 December 2025 single decks were sold in Battle Party: Shining Dream Deck boxes, one of 20 at random: the 18 decks and the holo Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR and Palkia VSTAR decks. Its cards are numbered out of 207; a full-art Iono is numbered 208.
